events.subtitle: 60th birthday & 50-year career anniversary live
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents the Wolfgang Haffner Trio for two sets on October 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue explicitly frames the one-night engagement as an anniversary concert celebrating Haffner's 60th birthday and 50-year career. Haffner appears with Simon Oslender on piano/keyboards and Thomas Stieger on bass, whom the venue describes as the core trio around his current musical activity, spanning jazz, rock, pop, funk and related groove-oriented language.

en.why_it_matters: This clears S because the anniversary is tied to the instrument and the working band rather than being decorative marketing: Haffner is marking both his 60th birthday and fifty years behind the drums in a single Tokyo club night with the compact trio at the center of his current musical world. Oslender and Stieger give him a setup built for pocket, rhythmic elasticity and fusion without turning the date into a large retrospective revue. The combination of a major European drummer, a genuine career milestone and an intimate one-night format makes this materially more distinctive than a routine tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one of the two sets and cross Tokyo for it if drums, groove and modern European fusion are part of the reason for the trip. It stops short of S+ because the anniversary is meaningful but not a farewell, reunion or singular historical event that would justify a transpacific trip on its own.

es.why_it_matters: Cruza a S porque el aniversario está ligado al instrumento y a la banda de trabajo, no sólo al marketing: Haffner celebra en una sola noche de club en Tokio tanto sus 60 años como medio siglo detrás de la batería, con el trío compacto que ocupa el centro de su lenguaje actual. Oslender y Stieger le dan un formato hecho para pocket, elasticidad rítmica y fusión sin convertir la fecha en una revista retrospectiva enorme. La combinación de un baterista europeo mayor, un hito real de carrera y una sola noche en sala íntima la vuelve sustancialmente más singular que una parada rutinaria de gira.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Sí protegería uno de los dos sets y cruzaría Tokio por esto si batería, groove y fusión europea moderna forman parte del viaje. No llega a S+ porque el aniversario importa, pero no es despedida, reunión ni acontecimiento histórico único que por sí solo justifique cruzar el Pacífico.
